Relay r of a board with @@# r <= HW_RELAY_COUNT ($b.Relays) is hard-wired: no port parameter, its page shows the fixed connection; every further @@# relay has its port parameter. @@# Relay r of board $b: parameter 200 + 50 (r-1) + index. @@# The relay IDs leave 50 numbers per relay; the data/clock port IDs of NeoPixel.hw.strip.xml (900/950 + board @@# number) have the same limit. The firmware reads the shared byte through NEOExternalRelayPort; the GPIO conflict @@# check reads the parameter of the selected board (HardwareManifest.xml ). @@if (MaxOf $Boards { $_.Slot } 0) -ge 50 {{ throw ("NeoPixel supports board numbers 0..49, the slot file gives " + (MaxOf $Boards { $_.Slot } 0)) }} @@end @@set $relays = Range 1 4 @@set $relayOffset = @(0, 1, 3, 4) @@set $relay = @{ Number = '%TT%{{D5 (200 + 50 * ($r - 1) + $b.Slot)}}' }
@@for $r in $relays @@use @hw/BoardParameter.xml ($relay + @{ Part = 'Parameter'; Offset = '{{$relayOffset[$r - 1]}}'; Name = 'NEORelay{{$r}}GPIOPortHW{{$b.Slot}}'; Type = 'NeoPixelGPIOPortHW{{$b.Slot}}'; Text = 'Relais {{$r}} Port'; Value = '15'; Where = { $_.Relays.Count -lt $r } }) @@end
@@for $r in $relays @@use @hw/BoardParameter.xml ($relay + @{ Part = 'ParameterRef'; Where = { $_.Relays.Count -lt $r } }) @@end
@@use @hw/BoardWhens.xml @{ Test = '={{$b.HwId}}'; Where = { $_.Val.Relays -eq 0 } } @@param Body
@@endparam @@enduse
@@for $r in $relays
@@use @hw/BoardParameter.xml ($relay + @{ Part = 'When'; IndentLevel = '2'; Where = { $_.Relays.Count -lt $r } })
@@use @hw/BoardWhens.xml @{ Where = { $_.Relays.Count -ge $r } } @@param Body
@@endparam @@enduse
@@use @hw/BoardParameter.xml ($relay + @{ Part = 'When'; Where = { $_.Relays.Count -lt $r } }) @@param Body
@@endparam @@enduse
@@end
